d: A massive controlled explosion rocked the US Army's old ammunition plant in Middletown, Iowa, on November 25, sending a huge cloud of white and brown smoke into the sky. The blast was part of a carefully planned operation to destroy nearly five tonnes of unstable lead azide, a highly sensitive explosive chemical that had been stored at the facility for years. The US Army decided to detonate the material after concerns that it could explode due to minor activity or exposure to cold temperatures.
